rationale.complete: Round 1 done: pre-registration, synthetic validation at the real design (with measured reliability), 17 per-period verdicts, rivals, robustness, post hoc checks and a dry-run confirm script. Holdout, an embedding swap and an hour-scale design are missing; the direction is low priority.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction failed. No inverted U (both slopes n.s.); PR10 does not beat FE + controls in day-blocked CV (C = 0); 0/14 periods supported, and the meta right slope has the wrong sign. The test had about 80% power for a 0.4-SD inverted U, so this is a fairly well-understood null, not just an untested one.
rationale.usefulness: A negative result about a plausible operator metric: within-agent daily content diversity is not a lever or monitor for output, with a computed bound (at most about 9% fewer write turns at the 90th percentile vs the best). It retires a dashboard idea but offers no knob.

one_line: No diversity-productivity optimum: agent-day content PR carries no usable information about write output (flat above PR10 = 14).

v2.rater: coordinator first pass (from integrated reports); independent rater pending
